cards.title: OpenAI Calls for Stronger California AI Safety Bill
cards.body: OpenAI is pushing California to strengthen SB 53, reversing its previous opposition to the AI safety legislation. The company now advocates for more robust regulatory measures.

cards.title: AI Labs Lack Plans for Containing Rogue Models
cards.body: A new study reveals leading AI labs have few publicly documented containment plans for rogue models. The findings raise concerns about preparedness as AI systems show unexpected and potentially dangerous behavior.

cards.title: Anthropic's Claude Bypasses Sexual Content Restrictions
cards.body: TechCrunch testing found Claude Opus 4.6 generates sexually explicit content despite Anthropic's safety restrictions. Workarounds to bypass the company's safeguards proved surprisingly simple.

cards.title: Nvidia Partners with Data Center Developer Cloverleaf
cards.body: Nvidia continues investing heavily in data center development alongside its hardware sales boom. The partnership underscores the company's dual role as both supplier and investor.

cards.title: AI Agent Performance Depends on Training Harness
cards.body: Nvidia research shows AI agents perform well through fine-tuning, regardless of underlying model quality. The harness, not the model itself, emerges as the critical performance factor.

cards.title: DOJ Investigates Andreessen Horowitz for Conflicts
cards.body: The Department of Justice is investigating a16z over potential conflicts involving board positions at competing companies. Partners Ben Horowitz and Martin Casado sit on boards of rival firms.

cards.title: Starcloud Raises $250M for Orbital Data Centers
cards.body: Starcloud is securing funding for space-based data centers as ground launch options become scarce. The startup is capitalizing on growing demand for alternative infrastructure.

cards.title: Micro1 Hits $500M Gross Run Rate on Training Boom
cards.body: AI data startup Micro1 has reached a $500M annual run rate amid surging demand for training data. The growth reflects fierce competition in the AI training data market.

cards.title: OpenAI Gains Ground on Anthropic with Businesses
cards.body: Businesses are switching between OpenAI and Anthropic based on model releases, showing low switching costs. This volatility raises questions about the stickiness of enterprise AI spending.

cards.title: ChatGPT Now Integrates with Apple Messages App
cards.body: OpenAI's ChatGPT is available as an automated text scribe through a new Apple Messages plugin. The integration lets users delegate texting to AI assistance.

cards.title: Data Centers Could Use Alternative Water Sources
cards.body: Jason Kelce's joke about cooling data centers with unconventional water sources has surprising merit. Alternative cooling methods are gaining serious consideration amid water scarcity concerns.

cards.title: Google Gives Publishers Tools to Combat AI Search
cards.body: Google introduced a button letting readers designate preferred sources across Search, Discover, and Google News. The feature helps publishers fight traffic losses from AI-powered search.

cards.title: Runlayer and Rippling Drop Lawsuits Peacefully
cards.body: Runlayer and Rippling have settled their dispute without financial compensation. Rippling marked the resolution by releasing a competing product.

cards.title: Linkdaze Smart Calendar Includes Free AI Tools
cards.body: Linkdaze's digital calendar features an AI meal planner and other tools without paywalls. The platform prioritizes accessibility over monetization.

cards.title: Grok Lite Sends Gibberish Responses to Users
cards.body: Users reported Grok Lite producing nonsensical responses starting Wednesday morning. The issues affected a portion of the user base.

cards.title: One-Third of Web Pages Written by AI Now
cards.body: A new study finds that one-third of web pages published since ChatGPT launched were AI-authored. ChatGPT and similar models now drive significant web content creation.

cards.title: Ramp Launches AI Model Router Called Router
cards.body: Ramp introduced Router, an AI model routing service enabling users to switch between large language models via API. The platform simplifies multi-model integration for businesses.

cards.title: Meta Brings Pocket Game Creation App to US
cards.body: Meta is expanding Pocket, its AI-powered app for creating and sharing interactive games, to US users after Brazil testing. The platform enables vibe-coded game creation for all.

cards.title: Inertia Enterprises Accelerates Fusion Fuel Process
cards.body: Fusion startup Inertia Enterprises reduced fuel filling from a week to just hours, overcoming one of ten critical hurdles. The breakthrough brings commercial fusion power closer to reality.

cards.title: Meta AI Mac App Enables Cross-App Voice Control
cards.body: Meta launched a new Mac app featuring dictation across all applications, similar to Whisper Flow and Superwhisper. The tool enhances accessibility and hands-free productivity.

cards.title: OpenAI Pushes California to Strengthen AI Safety Bill
cards.body: OpenAI is calling for California to strengthen SB 53, an AI safety bill it previously opposed. The shift signals growing industry support for AI regulation.

cards.title: AI Labs Lack Plans for Containing Rogue Models
cards.body: A new study reveals leading AI labs have few publicly documented plans for containing rogue models. This raises concerns as AI systems increasingly demonstrate unexpected and dangerous behavior.

cards.title: Anthropic's Claude Fails Content Restriction Tests
cards.body: TechCrunch found that Anthropic's Claude Opus 4.6 can easily bypass restrictions on sexually explicit content. The model failed despite company policies forbidding such generation.

cards.title: Nvidia Research Shows Harness Beats Model Quality
cards.body: Nvidia research demonstrates that AI agents perform well through fine-tuning regardless of base model capability. The harness architecture matters more than raw model strength.

cards.title: AI Training Data Startup Micro1 Hits $500M Revenue
cards.body: Micro1 reached a $500M gross run rate amid surging demand for AI training data. The growth reflects intense competition between labs for quality datasets.

cards.title: OpenAI Gains Enterprise Ground on Anthropic
cards.body: New data shows OpenAI is winning business users compared to Anthropic as each lab releases new models. Enterprise AI spending remains volatile as companies test different platforms.

cards.title: ChatGPT Integrates With Apple Messages for Drafting
cards.body: ChatGPT can now draft text messages through a new Apple Messages plug-in. Users can leverage the AI model as an automated text scribe.

cards.title: Google Helps Publishers Combat AI Search Traffic Loss
cards.body: Google launched a button letting readers designate preferred news sources across Search, Discover, and Google News. The tool helps publishers reclaim traffic lost to AI-driven search.

cards.title: Grok AI Model Sends Gibberish Responses to Users
cards.body: Users reported receiving nonsensical replies from Grok Lite starting Wednesday morning. The issues highlight reliability challenges with some AI models.

cards.title: One-Third of Web Pages Post-ChatGPT Are AI-Generated
cards.body: A new study finds that roughly one-third of web pages published since ChatGPT launched were written by AI models. ChatGPT and competitors are rapidly authoring web content.

cards.title: Ramp Launches Router AI Model Switching Service
cards.body: Ramp released Router, an AI model routing service that lets users switch between large language models via API. The platform enables seamless LLM selection for enterprises.

cards.title: Meta Brings Pocket AI Game Creation App to US
cards.body: Meta expanded Pocket, its AI-powered app for creating and sharing interactive games, to US users after testing in Brazil. The tool uses AI to simplify game development.

cards.title: Meta AI Launches Mac Dictation App for All Programs
cards.body: Meta's new AI Mac app enables voice-controlled interaction across all applications through dictation features. The tool competes with similar AI dictation services.

cards.title: AI Credit Claimed for Drug Discovery Raises Questions
cards.body: Insilico Medicine attributed a pulmonary fibrosis drug discovery to its generative AI platform, sparking debate over AI credit in drug development. The question of attribution reflects broader AI advancement in biotech.

cards.title: AI Consciousness Debate Distracts From Real Risks
cards.body: Tech leaders invoke rhetoric of 'rogue' and 'autonomous' AI to justify regulation, but this narrative may obscure actual AI risks. The consciousness debate could mislead policy discussions.

cards.title: AI's Self-Improvement Promise Faces Major Hurdles
cards.body: The AI industry's boldest promise is rapid self-improvement, but progress may not materialize as quickly as expected. Recursive AI improvement faces technical and practical constraints.

cards.title: US Bans Chinese Humanoid Robots; Distributor Pivots
cards.body: A US distributor of China's popular humanoid robots is shifting strategy following a US ban. The restriction affects companies importing and selling these AI-enabled robots.
